purpose: Teach: ワークス/昨年度/前記/隻/女史/船長/無職/北東

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、田中ワークスとの業務提携を検討しろ
lines.en: I want you to explore a business partnership with Tanaka Works.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Cool authority—not lecturing, just stating expectation. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。昨年度の決算を踏まえて計画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop a plan based on last year's financial results.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Even pace, clear articulation. Professional confirmation—no hesitation, no obsequiousness. Efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、前記の方針を社員に周知しろ
lines.en: Make sure this directive reaches all staff members.
lines.style: Firm, unhurried. Light emphasis on the action word. Tone of someone used to being obeyed without repetition. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。輸送船を二隻チャーターします
lines.en: Understood. I'll charter two transport vessels.
lines.style: Brief, competent nod in the voice. Quick tempo. Matter-of-fact—he's already thinking ahead. Confirms, then moves to execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 元政治家女史を顧問にお迎えしろ
lines.en: Bring on a former politician as an advisor.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Minimal words, maximum weight. The phrasing itself is economical. Spoken like someone accustomed to having ideas implemented immediately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。船長級の責任者を任命します
lines.en: Understood. I'll appoint someone at captain-level to lead the effort.
lines.style: Steady, professional. Slight nod of readiness in delivery. Tempo matches his boss's efficiency. Shows he understands the scope without needing clarification.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、無職期間がある応募者にも公平に対応しろ
lines.en: Treat applicants with employment gaps fairly and equally.
lines.style: Deliberate shift—warmer authority. Slight pause before the instruction, like emphasizing its importance. Quiet conviction. Not a suggestion, but said with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。北東方面の支店も視野に入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll also consider our northeastern branches in the plan.
lines.style: Businesslike closing. Steady, no rush. Demonstrates he's absorbed the full scope of instruction and is already integrating details. Composed.
